text.jp: 食欲感謝の日
text.real_en: Appetite Appreciation Day

text.jp:
宿屋で食事を行う際の
料理の価格が通常の半額になる
太陽祭

太陽神ソレルを讃える祭日
太陽の恵みに感謝を捧げる
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
The festival of Solel, the Sunbearer.
On this day, the people of Dagsion
give thanks for the sun's blessings.
text.real_en: A festival honoring Sorell, the sun god, and giving thanks for the sun's blessings. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: アウロラの星祭

星と航海の神アウロラに祈りを捧げ
１年の旅の安全を祈願する日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A day to pray to Aurora, the
Navigator's Clarion, for safe
sea voyages this year.
text.real_en: A day to pray to Aurora, god of the stars and navigation, for a year's safe travels. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: マーズ祭

軍神マーズの栄光を讃え
帝国の更なる発展を皆で祝す日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
Celebrating Mars, the Bringer of
War, and the further development
of the empire.
text.real_en: A festival celebrating the glory of Mars, god of war, and the empire's further growth. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: スミルノス魔道祭

魔道の神スミルノスを讃える日
魔道と帝国の発展を祈願する
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A day to petition Smyrnos, the
Spell-Scholar, for innovation in
magic and the empire.
text.real_en: A day to honor Smyrnos, god of magic, and pray for advances in magic and the empire. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: カーラの芸術祭
text.real_en: Cara's Arts Festival

text.jp:
狩猟と芸術の神カーラを讃える日
事を起こすのに良いとされる
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A day for Kalla, the Patron-
Huntress. Considered auspicious
for undertaking new ventures.
text.real_en: A day to honor Cara, god of hunting and art, considered auspicious for new undertakings. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: フォトナの運命祭
text.real_en: Fotona's Festival of Fate

text.jp:
運命の神フォトナに祈りを捧げ
平穏な生の有難味を噛みしめる日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A day for prayers to Fortuna,
Goddess of Fate, and for savoring
the blessings of a peaceful life.
text.real_en: A day to pray to Fotona, god of fate, and appreciate the blessing of a peaceful life. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: 天狼祭

神威大帝およびダグザ帝国にとり
重要な意味があるとされる日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A day of great importance to the
Divine Emperor and his empire.
All in Dagsion come out for it.

text.jp: 死者の祭り
text.real_en: Festival of the Dead

text.jp:
死と夜の神ユ・ファスに対し
祖先の魂の平穏を祈る祭り
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A solemn day to beseech Yu Phas,
Keeper of Death and Night, to lead
souls of ancestors to peace.
text.real_en: A festival praying to Yu Phas, god of death and night, for the peace of ancestral souls. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: ジュラの収穫祭

豊穣の女神ジュラに祈りを捧げ
来年の豊かな実りを祈願する祭り
この日は帝都に賑わいが満ちる
text.official_en:
A festival to pray to Jurah, the
Giver of Fertility, for a bountiful
harvest in the coming year.
text.real_en: A festival to pray to Jurah, goddess of fertility, for a bountiful harvest next year. The imperial capital is filled with celebration.

text.jp: クレールの槌祭
text.real_en: Claire's Hammer Day

text.jp:
鍛冶の神クレールを讃える祭日
各地から帝都に人が集まり
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
On this day, people from all over
Dagda flock to Dagsion to honor
Credna, Spark of the Forge.
text.real_en: People from all over Dagda gather in the imperial capital to honor Claire, god of smithing. The city is bustling with life today.

text.jp: 建国記念日

ダグザ帝国の成立を祝う記念日
特に盛大な祭りが行われ
帝都が熱気に包まれる日
text.official_en:
The anniversary of the founding of
the Dagdan Empire is always an
occasion for grand ceremonials.
text.real_en: The anniversary of the founding of the Dagdan Empire, celebrated with especially grand festivities throughout the imperial capital.

text.jp: 大ダグザ降臨祭

神威大帝ダグザがこの地に
降臨した日を記念する祝日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
A commemoration of the day on
which the Divine Emperor Dagda
descended to this land.
text.real_en: A holiday commemorating the day Divine Emperor Dagda descended upon this land. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp:

奉仕活動の効果が高まる

increased effects.

text.jp: ダグザの吉曜
text.real_en: Dagda's Auspicious Day

text.jp:
分殿で各神位との謁見が可能
全ての神殿で
奉仕活動の効果が高まる
text.official_en:
All gods receive guests at their
branch temples. Service at all
temples has increased effects.

text.jp: 破滅の蝕
text.real_en: Eclipse of Ruin

text.jp:
金環日食の到来とともに
バロールの力が頂点に達し
冥界から地上に出現するとされる
text.official_en:
On the arrival of the solar eclipse,
Balor's power reaches its peak,
spilling out from the underworld.
text.real_en: With the arrival of an annular solar eclipse, Balor's power is said to peak and he is believed to emerge from the underworld onto the surface.

text.jp: 大潮

潮流の変化により魚の活性が増す
ため、この日に魚を獲れば
豊漁になりやすいとされる
text.official_en:
The tide makes fish more active,
so fishing on this day is said to
increase the odds of a good catch.

text.jp: 闇夜の蓄積日

植物の根が活発になるため
この日に植物を採集すると
成果が得られやすいとされる
text.official_en:
Plant growth is stimulated on this
day, so it's an auspicious time to
harvest crops.
text.real_en: Plant roots become more active on this day, so gathering plants is said to yield better results.

text.jp: 玻璃輝の節

満月の光を宝石の輝きになぞらえ
この日に鉱物の採掘を行うと
成果が得られやすいとされる
text.official_en:
Under a full moon that shines
like a jewel, mining efforts are said
to yield more favorable results.

text.jp: 金烏の休息日

１月１７日の太陽祭を本祭とする
神威法王によって定められた祝日
この日は帝都が活気に溢れる
text.official_en:
The Divine Sovereign decreed that
the 17th of each month would be
a celebration of the sun's light.
text.real_en: A holiday established by the Divine Pontiff, with the Sun Festival on January 17 as its main celebration. The imperial capital is bustling with life today.

text.jp: 風変りな占い師
text.real_en: An Eccentric Fortune Teller

text.jp:
話題になっている占い師が
ダグシオンに出現するらしい
text.official_en:
The fortune teller causing a stir is
open for business in Dagsion.
text.real_en: A fortune teller everyone's talking about is said to be appearing in Dagsion.
